title: Dynamic Routes and Route Parameters
description: Handle variable segments in URLs and access parameters in components.

slides.title: Route Parameters
slides.content:
# Dynamic Segments

Use a colon `:` to mark a dynamic part of the URL:

```javascript
{ path: '/user/:id', component: User }
```

When the URL is `/user/123`, `params.id` will be `'123'`.

You can have multiple parameters: `/user/:userId/post/:postId`.

slides.title: Passing Props to Route Components
slides.content:
Instead of accessing `$route.params` inside the component, you can **pass props** to the component by setting `props: true` in the route definition.

```javascript
{ path: '/user/:id', component: User, props: true }
```

Then in the component, declare `props: ['id']` and use `id` directly.

This decouples the component from the router and makes it more reusable.

quizData.question: How do you access the route parameters inside a component using the Composition API?
quizData.explanation: In Composition API, you import `useRoute` from 'vue-router' and call it to get the current route object, then access `params`.
